[global]
server_name = "eno1.dev"
address = ["::"]
port = 8008

log = "info"

database_path = "/data"
database_backup_path = "/backups"
database_backups_to_keep = 1

rocksdb_compression_algo = "zstd"
rocksdb_compression_level = 32767
rocksdb_bottommost_compression_level = 32767
rocksdb_bottommost_compression = true

max_request_size = 20971520

query_over_tcp_only = true
ip_lookup_strategy = 3

allow_registration = true
registration_token_file = "/config/token"
new_user_displayname_suffix = ""

allow_federation = true

# Additional config
[global.well_known]
client = "https://m.eno1.dev"
server = "m.eno1.dev:443"

#support_page =
#support_role =
#support_email =
#support_mxid =

  title: Hankeln.Work
  description: Dashboard for Hankeln.Work Subdomains and other...

      path: https://github.com/lukashankeln/Homelab

      path: https://kube-the-home.github.io/kube-the-home/

log:
  level: debug
cache:
  enabled: true
container:
  require_docker: true
  docker_timeout: 300s
runner:
  labels:
    - "ubuntu-latest:docker://docker-registry.hankeln.work/gitea-runner:1.2.0"
    - "ubuntu-22.04:docker://docker-registry.hankeln.work/gitea-runner:1.2.0"
    - "ubuntu-20.04:docker://docker-registry.hankeln.work/gitea-runner:1.2.0"

global:
  output_dir: /data
  default_fps: 15.0
  motion_threshold: 1500
  blur_size: 7
  cooldown_secs: 10.0
  dilate_iters: 2
  clip_duration: 5.0
  pre_buffer_secs: 5.0
  max_videos: 100
  stale_days: 30

cameras:
  - name: webcam
    url: http://192.168.1.121:1984/api/stream.mjpeg?src=webcam
    motion_threshold: 30
